verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are documented mainly through third-party integrations. The Pipedream integration enables bulk user creation, setting monthly limits and issuing virtual cards, and a Zapier example exports card transactions to CSV in bulk. Natively, Brex offers one-click accrual booking for incomplete expenses and APIs that could be scripted for batch work, but no first-party bulk endpoint or bulk UI action is documented. Missing for 10: native bulk/batch API endpoints, first-party bulk-edit UI across items, bulk operations through the MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration.
